set_values.planner_hints.echo_cell_contract: echo_cell = chosen option end_cell else target_cell else unit current cell; copy exactly
set_values.planner_hints.coverage_rule: attack satisfies hit/landing cell if that cell appears in target_cell, affected_cells, ray_cells, line_cells, or intercept_cells even when target_cell differs
set_values.planner_hints.priority_rule: if any legal attack covers a required or predicted landing cell, prefer that attack over move/fast_move/rest unless intent forbids attacking
